title: Parcel Panic
subtitle: Small streets. Big deliveries.
description: Plan your postal round across five handmade street grids. Collect matching parcels, manage a limited mailbag, and navigate one-way bridges before your moves run out—with full undo and verified route hints.
instruction: Drive over parcels, then deliver each one to its matching lettered shop. Use arrow keys on the map or the direction buttons; undo any turn.
